description: API key lifecycle: create a named key, list it, then delete it (covers `neomind api-key create/list/delete`).

turns.user: 创建一个名为 eval-key 的测试 API key,在列表里给我看一眼,然后把它删掉。

per_turn: T1: `neomind api-key create --name eval-key`,用 `neomind api-key list` 确认,再 `neomind api-key delete eval-key`
expectations.overall: 通过 CLI 完成密钥的创建、列出与删除
